_comment: Core Web Vitals performance budget. One entry per project. Targets use Google's 'Good' thresholds by default. Adjust per-project when the project has a measured, documented reason to differ. All times are in milliseconds; CLS is unitless.

_vitals_reference.LCP: Largest Contentful Paint — how long until the largest image or text block is visible. Good: ≤ 2500ms.
_vitals_reference.INP: Interaction to Next Paint — how long the page takes to respond to a user action (click, tap, key). Good: ≤ 200ms.
_vitals_reference.CLS: Cumulative Layout Shift — how much visible content unexpectedly moves during load. Good: ≤ 0.1 (unitless score).
_vitals_reference.FCP: First Contentful Paint — how long until the first text or image is painted. Good: ≤ 1800ms.
_vitals_reference.TTFB: Time to First Byte — how long until the browser receives the first byte of the page. Good: ≤ 800ms.

default._description: Fallback targets used when no project-specific entry exists. Based on Google 'Good' CWV thresholds.
